About me

Hands-on engineer, from firmware to front desk

I'm a Systems Engineer in the Systems Assembly department at Aflak Electronic Industries Co. Ltd (Sudair Industrial and Business City, Saudi Arabia), where I've worked since 2018 across IT support, R&D electronics and end-to-end delivery of specialized systems.

My core work is the Car Parking Smart Kiosk Suite: entry, payment and exit kiosks with QR/RFID ticketing, NFC and mobile payments (Mada, STC Pay, Apple Pay, Visa), session tracking and full technical documentation — from wiring and firmware recovery of Android motherboards to the payment-terminal integration.

Around that, the same role covers network and endpoint support across the plant — Cisco VLAN, OSPF and routing, access-lists, Active Directory and Remote Desktop, imaging, antivirus and helpdesk for both factory and office — plus access-control and E-gate deployment, and the evaluation reports, technical documentation and client-facing reviews that go with each handover.

Beyond the factory floor I build my own tools, and this page shows 19 of them running: Windows desktop applications for production planning and network monitoring, a voice-assistant stack, an in-car head-unit interface, and eleven Android apps. Eight of those Android apps ship as signed, self-contained APKs that request no INTERNET permission and carry no baked API key. I document everything I ship.
